content.value:
A DECISION, NOT A BUILD. Charter D185 RULES that this epic does NOT rebase #10129: a textual rebase silently mints two unratified ladder rulings (deploys_failing outranking strained/filling/unreported, and unmetered as a discontiguous rung against main's landed non-rung precedent), and its unmetered fixture ships tone:"" which main's vocabulary pin now forbids.

The wave-24 lead notes say 'rebase-not-close #10129'. That OVERRIDES a ratified decision. Charter D428 records the tension and defers to D185; wave 24 does not slice it.

STATE OF THE PR, re-derived 2026-08-08: all four required contexts GREEN, and it PASSES the task gate today (open_lead +1737s) -- the gate is push-invariant, so a rebase-and-push is SAFE from the lease angle. It CONFLICTS with main in SIX paths: cloud/priv/static/fixtures/attention_order.json, internal/cli/cloud_status_cmd.go(+test), internal/cli/testdata/attention_order_cases.json, internal/cloudclient/client.go, internal/semrole/semrole.go. That set is UNCHANGED after the four predecessors merge, so ordering buys it nothing.

NEVER close/reopen it and never re-cut it onto a fresh PR -- a fresh created_at is past every lapse and the required task gate reds for real.

What is owed: the lead either supersedes D185 in writing (ratifying the two ladder rulings on their merits) or closes the PR. Leaving it open a fourth wave is the cost.
